text.en: The business began on Panganiban Drive, across from St. John Hospital.
A 2016 account dates its move to SM City Naga to around 2009.
Naga City Deck describes the Villa Caceres ground-floor branch in its Venetian-style wing.
The reviewed cake range includes Oreo cheesecake, ube cake and chocolate mousse.
